criterion: After a picker is answered, the screen keeps one line that names the choice in full, with no description cut off by an ellipsis.
evidence: cli/ui.go receiptLine never cuts the choice; the question yields space down to receiptTitleFloor. go test ./cli/ -count=1 ok (5.149s): TestReceiptNeverCutsTheChoiceIssue361, TestSearchReceiptNamesTheLabelNotTheDescriptionIssue361 (receipt names 'Custom endpoint', not the description). pty screen() assertions in tests/cli_picker_test.py run in CI.

criterion: After a typed question is answered, the screen keeps one line with the question and the answer, and no key hint. A hidden answer shows no text.
evidence: cli/ui.go uiInput folds the prompt block with eraseLines(2 + typedLines(echoed)); an answer too long to share the line keeps its question whole and wraps beneath it; a secret prints the question alone. go test ok: TestTypedLinesCountsTheWrap, TestReceiptNeverCutsTheChoiceIssue361 (120-cell answer keeps '  Value: › '). pty test_answered_input_folds_to_one_summary_line_issue_361 runs in CI; the exact Go byte stream was replayed through screen() offline (6/6).

criterion: The sign-in, provider and model pickers leave summary lines of the same shape.
evidence: All three end in receiptLine ('Title › choice'); search passes the original row's label, numbered folds to the same receipt. pty screen() assertions for '  Sign-in method — demo › API key', '  Provider — demo › Anthropic', '  Default model — demo › picker-beta' run in CI; offline replay of the native and numbered streams confirmed the one-line shape.
